question: What is the central concern raised in the passage?

options.text: Striking a balance between tradition and commercial interests

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage highlights an ongoing debate in cricket regarding the need to preserve the traditional depth and strategic richness of Test cricket.
 
• At the same time, it emphasizes the rising commercial appeal and fast-paced entertainment value of ODIs.
 
• The author stresses the challenge of maintaining the sanctity of Test cricket without compromising the popularity and economic viability of ODIs.
 
• Thus, the central concern is striking a balance between traditional values and commercial interests.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Relevant Line from the Passage:** *"…how to preserve the sanctity of Test cricket without undermining the accessibility and commercial appeal of ODIs — a delicate balance cricketing authorities must negotiate…"* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: Lack of players** – The passage does not mention any shortage of players.
 
• **Option 2: Scheduling challenges** – While an important issue in cricket, it is not discussed in the passage.
 
• **Option 4: Reducing formats to two** – The passage does not argue for the removal of any format.
